member.idle_admission_telemetry_missing.note: HAZARD path (core-prune A18): every failed idle-admission condition was an evidence condition (CPU telemetry missing, malformed or too few samples; GPU admission unknown), so the member runs; its idle-window quietness is unmeasured. A threshold failure still retries and aborts as before.

member.reduction_mismatch.note: Re-reduction is not byte-identical to the stored summary.

member.span_unknown.note: The member's sampler span cannot be placed, so the physics-in-span rules cannot be applied.

member.timeout.note: The member's child was killed at the 1,800 s wall-clock cap. A member stopped by its cap is not a completed measurement (PLAN2 row 8).

roster.before_chain_started.note: The only one of the four ignored-bundle codes that removes a member under its own name. As a flag: the harvest writes it on a roster member whose run started (its run_started wall time) before chain.started's wall time, and the exclusion function removes that member under this code. As a label: the exclusion function gives it to a bundle whose creation stamp is earlier than chain.started's monotonic stamp; the bundle is ignored, not used, and listed in the exclusion record's bundles_ignored, and a roster member left with no admissible bundle is removed as member.bytes_missing (registration 6.7).

roster.creation_unplaced.note: A label only; no program writes it as a flag, so no member is removed under this code. When chain.started carries a monotonic stamp and a bundle has no stamp that places it against that moment (no member-span, controller or run_started stamp), the exclusion function ignores the bundle, like an early one, and lists it in the exclusion record's bundles_ignored; a roster member left with no admissible bundle is removed as member.bytes_missing. The four tests run in this order: not in the roster, another attempt, cannot be placed, created early. Added after the end-to-end rehearsal, round 1 (B7).

roster.dispatch_unresolved.note: A stage's member dispatch could not be resolved from its config-dir order manifest (J3); its members were taken from the stage input as before (PLAN2 row 14).

roster.duplicate_run_id.note: CA-13: duplicated positions have no unit.

roster.foreign_attempt.note: A label only; no program writes it as a flag, so no member is removed under this code. The exclusion function gives it to a bundle bound to another attempt than the plan's; the bundle is ignored, not used, and listed in the exclusion record's bundles_ignored, and a roster member left with no admissible bundle is removed as member.bytes_missing. It cannot occur in a harvest at H_claim: the harvest gives every bundle either the plan's own attempt or none, and a bundle with no attempt is not foreign.

roster.horizon_truncated.note: The chain reached its collection deadline (pre-capture + 86,400 s minus settle, post-capture and margin) and stopped launching members so the post-calibration stays inside the 24 h horizon. The unlaunched members are absent from the roster; cell.below_minimum excludes where that matters (PLAN2 row 17).

roster.no_science_bundles.note: No planned science member has a bundle.

roster.not_in_plan.note: Removes no member, whatever the effect recorded here. As a flag: the harvest writes it for a bundle directory in a runs root whose name is not a roster run id; the flag names that directory, matches no roster member, is counted in flag_counts.unmatched_member and removes nothing. As a label: the exclusion function gives it to a bundle whose run id is not in the roster; the bundle is ignored, not used, and listed in the exclusion record's bundles_ignored.

roster.run_id_mismatch.note: The bundle's metadata.json run_id differs from its directory. A misfiled bundle already fails the per-member config check; this covers a bundle whose own records disagree about which member it is. A kept member needs one identity in every record a later program may key on, or one energy could count under two units or the wrong quad position (registration 6.7). The emitter and the test fixture now carry the same class and effect (audit-fix item 7, 2026-10-07); configs/gates/hazard_refusals.json lists it as a NUMBER_INTEGRITY member exclusion.

model.identity_underivable.note: The member's model and runtime identity cannot be derived from its own metadata; which model was measured is unproven for that member. On a NEG-8 reference or spare it is also a reference loss: that reference is dropped and the survivors rule of registration 0.12 decides the screen (orchestrator ruling N8). With no sealed neg8_reference pin and no strict majority among the references, every reference gets this code (observed.reason reference_identity_without_majority); the block-5 identity pins carry that pin, so with the pins present the expected identity is the pin.

model.source_unpinned.note: HV-21: an observed source without a pin discloses; no measured byte difference.

model.stack_differs_from_registered.note: HV-21: runtime, kernel packages, tokenizer or quantization changes the executed computation.

records.auxiliary_match_raised.note: The external-member auxiliary configuration match raised an exception. The refusal it causes stands; this flag records its cause (PLAN2 row 5).

records.checkout_untracked.note: Untracked files in the measurement checkout outside the executed roots.

records.collector_failed.note: A harvest collector failed; the number-protecting ones also emit their own unmeasured code.

records.flag_unbuilt.note: Audit-fix 2: a writer that could not build or write its flag printed its designed stand-in line ({code, level, run_id, [observed,] unbuilt}; joulewise.flags.core.emit and the chain's flag writer). The harvest rebuilt the flag the line names, so that flag's catalog effect applies and no exclusion is lost; a stage or quad fact, or a member fact with no run id, is applied to the whole window. This code records the rebuild.

records.identity_unmeasured_superseded.note: An arm collector's *.identity_unmeasured flag was superseded because the harvest re-derived every check that collector performs (PLAN2 row 12): pack, checkout and executed code (for the pack collector the harvest must also have run the checkout's tracked-edits and untracked-files checks, and every collection stage's member dispatch must have resolved; otherwise the arm's pack.identity_unmeasured stays and removes the window); and, since Opus audit F5 (2026-10-07), model identity, when the harvest read the pins and compared the identity of every succeeded science member (at least one) with a pin. The original flag is kept in the record.

records.lineage_formality.note: A lineage formality other than configuration bytes; also the driver's launch-lineage publication that failed after its one retry (the chain still launches, except for an unusable pack inventory, which refuses the window as night_refused_pack_inventory_unusable). observed.science_members_expected_to_refuse lists the runs roots whose locator is not valid and could not be read, where members would take the legacy path and refuse (audit A5, 2026-10-07).

records.lineage_prelaunch_mismatch.note: The driver's pre-launch lineage check found a runs-root locator absent, unreadable, rejected by the members' authenticator, or naming another window's plan, window or bracket session. Recorded with the observed and expected values and observed.science_members_expected_to_refuse (audit A5); the chain launches. Only a boot changed since publication refuses (night_refused_boot_changed).

records.malformed_flag.note: A flag line that failed validation: torn, not JSON, or not a valid joulewise.flag.v1 record. DISCLOSE since audit-fix 2 (Opus triple audit F2, 2026-10-07); it used to be deliberately unclassified, which blocked release with no cure. What the line still shows of its code decides whether one of the two conservative exclusions below is added: records.malformed_flag_exclusion_possible or records.malformed_flag_member_exclusion_possible.

cell.below_minimum.note: A target cell kept fewer than rules.cell_unit_minimum units in a stratum (derived by the exclusion function). The minimum is 5 since stage 1 of the seal gate (2026-10-07; it was 8). Below 5 kept units in a stratum the registered floor guard (small_sample_guard_factor) is undefined, so the cell's floor and every contrast judged against it have no number. From 5 to 9 kept units the registered estimators give a correct number with a wider interval, and a wider interval removes nothing (registration 6.6).
